comments.author: @barbaraeofmartinezhiei483
comments.text: Lake Kaindy looks like something straight out of a movie. The natural landscapes in this country are criminally underrated!

replies.author: @GlobeDiscovery-NY
replies.text: Couldn't agree more! Standing in front of the sunken forest at Lake Kaindy genuinely feels surreal, like stepping onto a fantasy film set. Central Asia’s nature is one of the world's best-kept secrets. Thanks so much for watching and sharing your thoughts!
